name: page-header
title: Page header
description: The top of a page: breadcrumbs, title, description and actions.
a11y: The title is a real heading (h1 by default); keep one h1 per page.
Breadcrumbs and actions are slots, so they keep their own landmark and keyboard behaviour.

props.name: title
props.description: The page title, rendered as a heading.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence under the title saying what the page is for.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: Shown above the title: a `Breadcrumb` or `BreadcrumbsAuto`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the end of the title row. They wrap under the title on small screens.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level, 1 to 4. Default 1: one per page.
